name: DFW Eclipse Cubing 2024
information: This competition is taking place the weekend before the [Total Solar Eclipse](https://science.nasa.gov/eclipses/future-eclipses/eclipse-2024/where-when/), which will pass through the DFW area on Monday, April 8, 2024. - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWEclipseCubing2024#39600-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWEclipseCubing2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/). To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
